detail.longDescription: I am developing hardware products with NFC and BLE. I built this browser because I lack support of WebNFC and WebBluetooth in existing browsers. Using a native app or a spare Android phone is not the fastest way to test a new feature / integration in my hardware. How it works: it uses WebKit and standard WebNFC/WebBluetooth Javascript interfaces - so any existing js app will work. How to try: github or app store Plans: security/privacy focus - isolation mode for specific websites to prevent XSS/Prompt injection
